assembled_from: Official manufacturer product pages and one technical data sheet, inspected 2026-10-20; claims remain unverified for user's specimen

sources.title: 832HD Black Epoxy for PCB Potting
sources.claim: 832HD is hard rigid permanent epoxy encapsulant for populated PCBs, low viscosity but not a special thermally conductive grade; unserviceable once cured

sources.title: 832FX Flexible Epoxy Potting Compound
sources.claim: 832FX flexible lower-modulus potting for thermally cycled electronics, not independently validated for a selected component

sources.title: BERGQUIST GAP PAD TGP HC5000 TDS (August 2022)
sources.claim: HC5000 is a compressible 5.0 W/m/K thermal gap pad in listed nominal thicknesses; actual thermal impedance depends on pressure, gap and contact surfaces; manufacturer typical values are not design certification

sources.title: 860 Silicone CPU Thermal Paste
sources.claim: 860 is electrically insulating and reworkable thermal paste, not adhesive or a rigid gap filler; mechanical retention needed

sources.title: 1035 Premium RTV Glue for Electronics
sources.claim: 1035 is neutral cure electronic silicone sealant intended to reduce corrosive acid vapor exposure; actual copper, plastic and seal design still require verification

sources.title: MOLYKOTE 111 Compound
sources.claim: Silicone valve and O-ring lubricating/sealing compound; compatible with many, not every, plastics and elastomers; not an electrically conductive contact lubricant

sources.title: MOLYKOTE 55 O-Ring Grease
sources.claim: O-ring grease designed to lubricate and slightly swell some elastomers, which is not interchangeable with dimensional-stability sealing compound; check grade before use

sources.title: MOLYKOTE YM-102 Grease
sources.claim: PAO grease developed for plastic gear/slide friction and low-seepage applications; actual plastic resin and neighboring electronics must be checked

sources.title: 846 Carbon Conductive Grease
sources.claim: 846 is electrically conductive contact lubrication that can reduce connection resistance; not an electrical insulator or thermal interface material

sources.title: Electronics Water Damage
sources.claim: Liquid-damage assessment requires isolation, identifying corrosion and deciding whether contamination or loss of metal/insulation requires replacement

methods.label: MG 832HD rigid electronic potting feasibility
validation: Verify exact resin and hardener TDS/SDS, exotherm, cure shrinkage, working time and assembly thermal load
Evaluate inaccessible-component repair loss and enclosure filling/void risk
Test dielectric, component stress and thermal cycling on representative surrogate populated assembly
failure_modes: Voids, entrapped moisture, hidden corrosion and local cure overheating

methods.label: MG 832FX flexible electronic potting feasibility
validation: Verify actual resin cure/exotherm and device power/thermal conditions
Measure thermomechanical strain of components and adhesion to installed parts
Test environmental ageing, rework loss, coating compatibility and leakage
failure_modes: Unverified heat dissipation and water ingress paths

methods.label: Henkel HC5000 compliant thermal gap-pad screening
validation: Measure real assembled bondline thickness, clamp pressure, compression and part tolerances
Use TDS impedance-versus-deflection reference at similar thickness; bulk k alone is not interface thermal resistance
Measure representative power-device temperature under realistic heat load and reassembly
failure_modes: High contact/interface thermal resistance despite material k
Board stress, gap/tolerance mismatch or poor contact

methods.label: MG 860 reworkable silicone thermal paste for thin interfaces
validation: Verify thin, mechanically retained heat-sink interface; not a standalone adhesive or large-gap support
Check actual dielectric limits, pump-out/aging, adjacent components and current product TDS
Measure thermal performance after reassembly and thermal cycling
failure_modes: No mechanical retention of heat sink
Paste pump-out, drying, spread to electronics
Large unfilled gap and unexpectedly high operating temperature

methods.label: MG 1035 neutral-cure RTV electronics sealant assessment
validation: Confirm actual surface treatment, adhesion and seal geometry under water, thermal cycling and ageing
Verify current neutral-cure product revision, cure in confined gaps, moisture path and corrosion compatibility
Test environmental ingress, rework feasibility and cure completion on representative assembly
failure_modes: Uncured seal in enclosed deep joint

methods.label: DuPont MOLYKOTE 111 O-ring lubrication/sealing screening
validation: Confirm actual O-ring elastomer grade, lubricant compatibility and exposure medium
Evaluate compression set, swelling, dimensional tolerance and long-term seal performance
Verify manufacturer's actual use certification if food/water/oxygen/medical application is relevant

methods.label: DuPont MOLYKOTE 55 swelling O-ring grease screening
validation: Assess whether intentional swelling can be tolerated within the O-ring groove
Consult current DuPont TDS for prohibited/untested grades and compatibility warnings
Check dimensional change, leak/pressure performance and long-term movement in representative assembly
failure_modes: Improper seal compression and lubricant migration

methods.label: DuPont MOLYKOTE YM-102 plastic gear/slide grease research
validation: Verify exact gear/slide resin, metal/plastic pairing and mechanical loading
Check creep, lubricant bleed into optics, contacts and adjacent plastics
Measure noise, friction, dimensional change and wear over representative cycles

methods.label: MG 846 conductive carbon grease contact screening
validation: Confirm product truly requires an electrically conductive contact layer, not dielectric insulation
Check electrical clearance, neighboring circuit contamination and application-specific contact geometry
Measure contact resistance, leakage pathways, cycles and corrosion performance
failure_modes: Conductive grease leakage causing short circuit
False assumption grease is dielectric insulation

methods.label: Corroded connector/trace replacement investigation
validation: Distinguish superficial surface deposits from loss of conducting metal/trace and substrate integrity
Verify moisture source and electrolytic damage are controlled before replacement
Compare replacement/board level repair economics with hidden corrosion uncertainties
failure_modes: Poor replacement part fit or solder damage
